 FT: Bayern 2-2 Arsenal - Eze replaces injured Saka and puts Gunners ahead; Davies responds and Kane nets from spot but Rice levels
 Villa 3-1 Viking - Barkley with opener, Buendia doubles lead from spot before Heggheim own goal; Christiansen responds
 FT: Como 4-1 Man Utd - Paz curls superb opener for hosts after two minutes, Douvikas doubles lead after break before Paz grabs his second and Jacobo Ramon makes it four. Zirkzee with last response

 I think there was a bit more of a freedom to this game, certainty from Timber, who had a license every time that David Raya had the ball, Raya's distribution was really good, Timber was on his bike picking up loose balls, second balls, flicking them on.

 'I love this club' published at 22:01 BST 22:01 BST 
 FT: Aston Villa 3-1 Viking 
 Aston Villa 
 Aston Villa goalscorer Emiliano Buendia told TNT Sports: "Very good. 
 "These type of teams come in here with energy and they want to show their character. We respect them a lot. 
 "I should score more. I had chances. I'm pleased. Important win."
 On Alysson: "He was incredible. He's showing his potential and his ability on the wing. Mbaye as well. It's important to have them. They are young talents.
 "I love this club."

 FULL-TIME published at 21:59 BST 21:59 BST 
 Club Brugge made light work of Lens to record a second win of the Champions League campaign, while Inter Milan, Real Betis and LASK all held on to earn slender victories over their opponents.
 Club Brugge 3-0 Lens
 Inter Milan 1-0 Shakhtar Donetsk
 Real Betis 1-0 Feyenoord
 Sporting CP 2-3 Lask

 'Two top teams going toe to toe' published at 21:58 BST 21:58 BST 
 Bayern Munich 2-2 Arsenal 
 Matt Upson 
Former Arsenal defender on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 A point each and a brilliant game to be honest. I thought it was excellent. 
 We have seen some top quality moments in this football match top to bottom. Goalkeeper saves, distribution, goal kicks from Harry Kane which have practically been an assist. Super passes from Odegaard and Kane, finishes, chances in the box.
 Two top teams going toe to toe in a more relaxed fashion knowing that there isn't a knockout at the end of this game and I think that showed in the way both teams approached it.

Former Leeds striker on TNT Sports 
 Professional performance. Yes, Aston Villa have conceded a goal but I do think for the majority of this game, they have been in complete control.

 FT: Real Madrid 4-1 RB Leipzig 
 Elizabeth Conway 
BBC Sport Spanish football reporter at the Bernabeu 
 Full time here at the Bernabeu. 
 A good 4-1 win for Real who seemed to find a new level in the last 20 minutes with some impressive individual goals. 
 It's an important win in the league phase but also a massive confidence boost going into Sunday's Clasico... what a test that will be.
